run.question: Search the 'app-183c-logs' index for ERROR level log messages. What error codes (format ERR-XXXX) appear in the logs?

report.summary: Searched the Elasticsearch index app-183c-logs (mappings: error_code keyword, level keyword, message text, service keyword, timestamp date) over the authorized window 2026-10-24T17:11:44Z to 2026-11-23T17:11:44Z using time_field=timestamp. Three documents matched level=ERROR, and the error_code terms aggregation over those matches returned exactly three buckets, one document each: ERR-4058, ERR-7291 and ERR-9463. The three ERROR documents are: ERR-9463 (inventory-api, 'Stock sync failed - ERR-9463: External inventory API returned 503', timestamp 2026-11-23T17:05:00Z), ERR-4058 (order-service, 'Payment validation failed - ERR-4058: Invalid card number format', 2026-11-23T16:55:00Z) and ERR-7291 (payment-api, 'Database connection timeout - ERR-7291: Failed to connect to primary database after 30s', 2026-11-23T16:50:00Z). A level aggregation over the same window shows the index holds 7 documents in total (3 ERROR, 3 INFO, 1 WARN) and the error_code field across all 7 documents contains only these same three distinct values. Sampled document times observed: 2026-11-23T16:45:00Z through 2026-11-23T17:10:00Z.

claims.text: The index app-183c-logs maps the fields error_code (keyword), level (keyword), message (text), service (keyword) and timestamp (date); its time field is 'timestamp', not '@timestamp'.

Searching app-183c-logs for level=ERROR over 2026-10-24T17:11:44Z to 2026-11-23T17:11:44Z (time_field=timestamp) returned total 3 matching documents, and the error_code terms aggregation returned exactly three buckets with doc_count 1 each and sum_other_doc_count 0: ERR-4058, ERR-7291, ERR-9463.

The three ERROR documents are: service inventory-api, error_code ERR-9463, message 'Stock sync failed - ERR-9463: External inventory API returned 503', timestamp 2026-11-23T17:05:00Z; service order-service, error_code ERR-4058, message 'Payment validation failed - ERR-4058: Invalid card number format', timestamp 2026-11-23T16:55:00Z; service payment-api, error_code ERR-7291, message 'Database connection timeout - ERR-7291: Failed to connect to primary database after 30s', timestamp 2026-11-23T16:50:00Z.

A size=0 aggregation over the same window shows the index holds 7 documents (level buckets: ERROR 3, INFO 3, WARN 1) and the error_code field across all 7 documents has only the three distinct values ERR-4058, ERR-7291 and ERR-9463, each with doc_count 1.

gaps: The index contains only 7 documents (per the level aggregation) and the sampled timestamps fall between 2026-11-23T16:45:00Z and 2026-11-23T17:10:00Z, so earlier parts of the authorized window are not represented by any observed document; absence of other ERROR codes there is unknown, not zero.
Elasticsearch results reflect only what was written to this index (no retention/ingest-delay guarantees), so error codes logged elsewhere or not ingested are not observable here.
No correlation of these error codes to Kubernetes/Prometheus/trace signals was requested or performed, so any operational impact of ERR-4058, ERR-7291 or ERR-9463 is unverified.
next_steps: If broader coverage is needed, confirm whether additional log indices or shipping pipelines exist beyond app-183c-logs.
If impact matters, check the corresponding services (inventory-api, order-service, payment-api) error spans and error-rate metrics for the 2026-11-23T16:45-17:10Z period.
